title: Novice Trade: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
text:
Novice Trade: SPDR S&P 500 ETF By Mark Sebastian | Apr 19, 2018 | 3:44 PM EDT 
This is the least fearful selloff we have seen this year. While the S&P 500 is down nearly 1%, the VIX hasn't moved, and as the day has progressed, even as the market has sold off, the VIX has not been able to catch any sort of bid. Yes, Apple (AAPL) looks ugly, but this selloff feels like a one-off test of the 50-day moving average (filling the gap they call it in the technical world). 
I would be a buyer of SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) calls against this move playing for a bounce. Monday's SPY 269 calls, which were $1.30 in the money Wednesday cost less than a dollar. Given that I think SPY is going to run right back above 270 I like this as a near-dated swing trade looking for a market bounce --probably Friday....8
